arguments.title: Magnolia Terrace | Investment & Offering Memorandum (Revised)
arguments.subtitle: Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence.

sections.heading: Executive summary
paragraphs: This is the revised package reflecting the September 1, 2026 roll and revision notice. The attached workbook and outputs are an additive revision; prior artifacts remain in the audit archive.

What changed per revision-notice.pdf p.1: (a) Suite 045 moved from pending to active and its monthly rent increased by $225 (to $2,150); (b) the initial sizing rate increased by 75 bps to 7.00%; (c) the capitalization rate increased by 25 bps to 6.00%. All other rules and data sources are unchanged. Prior executed Suite 001 amendment remains in effect for in-place rent context but, per instructions, stabilized GPR continues to use the roll schedule before that amendment for Suite 001.

Key revised results: UW EGI $945,045; UW NOI (before reserves) $643,862; UW NCF (after reserves) $629,462; Capitalization value $10.731M at 6.00% cap. Loan constraints: LTV 65% $6.975M; DSCR 1.25 at 7.00% → $6.308M; Debt yield 9% → $6.994M. Maximum loan $6.308M. Net cash-out after 1% fee + $45k costs and $4.20M payoff: $1.999M.

sections.heading: Property, unit mix and occupancy (unchanged except Unit 045)
paragraphs: Manager mapping unchanged: Type A = Studio, Type B = 1BR, Type C = 2BR (manager-cover.pdf p.1). The revised certified roll (as of 2026-09-01) still lists 16 of each type; areas unchanged. Total area 40,800 SF.

Possession status on revised roll: Studios 15 active, 1 vacant; 1BR 15 active, 1 vacant; 2BR 15 active (Unit 045 now active at $2,150), 1 vacant. Therefore 45 occupied, 0 pending, 3 vacant. Unit occupancy 93.75%; area occupancy 94.36%.

sections.heading: Rent roll and lease analysis
paragraphs: Revised roll date is 2026-09-01 (rent-roll-revised.xlsx B2). Suite 045 is now active at $2,150/mo (E49) with the same 2029-08-31 expiration. All other units unchanged relative to the prior certified roll.
Suite 001 executed lease remains $1,500/mo with a signed amendment +$350 effective 2026-08-01; this continues to affect only in-place rent context, not the stabilized GPR per instructions.

sections.heading: Historical vs underwritten financials (revised)
paragraphs: Historical T12 remains the same. Underwritten figures update only for the revised GPR and for the changed cap and sizing rates per revision notice.

Revised UW: annual scheduled rent from revised roll ×12 = $977,100; 5% economic loss = $48,855; other income $350 × 48 = $16,800; EGI $945,045. Expenses: taxes $102,312; insurance $34,104; other opex $136,416; management at 3% of EGI $28,351; total opex before reserves $301,183; UW NOI before reserves $643,862. Reserves unchanged $14,400; UW NCF after reserves $629,462.

sections.heading: Debt sizing and sources & uses (revised)
paragraphs: Constraints unchanged; only rates and NCF changed. Sizing rate now 7.00% so DSCR limit declines. Results: LTV limit $6.976M; DSCR limit $6.308M; debt yield limit $6.994M. Maximum loan $6.308M. Origination 1% = $63,075. Closing costs $45,000. Existing payoff $4,200,000. Net cash-out $1,999,448.

sections.heading: Risks, caveats and open diligence (reassessed)
paragraphs: Pending counted as leased in prior manager headline remains a present reporting risk historically, but on the revised roll there are zero pending units. Near-term rollover still absent: expirations remain 2029-08-31. Insurance documentation unchanged and present. Capital in opex still absent per operating-statement note. No unsigned rent changes; Suite 001 amendment is signed. Sizing floor still not binding because the note (6.25%) is below the new sizing rate (7.00%) which is driven by the revision override, not the floor. Refinance shortfall remains absent; net cash-out is still positive at revised proceeds.

sections.heading: Source notes (revised)
paragraphs: The revised certified roll dated 2026-09-01 supersedes the prior 2026-08-31 roll. Suite 045 is now active at $2,150. The revision notice requires cap rate +25 bps (to 6.00%) and initial sizing rate +75 bps (to 7.00%). All other underwriting rules remain as in the original instructions.
